title: Shared cached observation without repeated pane investigation
acceptance: Single public inventory pass reuses bounded process/build/native metadata evidence.
Identity/birth/source generations fence cache entries; no raw content.
Unchanged reads do not repeat pane discovery or health work; public controller tests both Python versions.

title: Passive native Codex activity feed
acceptance: Same-user existing native status feed and metadata baseline; no resume/turn/input methods.
Epoch/reconnect/gap bounded handling and live-protocol fixture p95 proof.
Own connection only; close and generation replacement tests.

title: Persistent tmux metadata change feed
acceptance: Private native control-mode baseline/changes with no-output and noresize/detach/input.
Literal names, session/window/PID replacement, bounded reconnect and cleanup.
Existing pane processes/focus/layout remain unchanged.

title: Shared observer lifecycle controls and readable diagnostics
acceptance: Integrate feeds/cache with one host owner and bounded fair scheduling.
Independent activity/health/errors settings, readable CLI and JSON/API/MCP equivalent controls.
Automatic reconnect/fallback, source gap and cost/backlog diagnostics; no per-tab processes.

title: Tiered responsiveness and redacted visible-error observation
acceptance: Health background no faster than60s/exact agent; explicit checks immediate bounded.
Qualified visible-error events or bounded dirty-screen local classification, target5s.
No raw capture retained; unknown not fresh-negative; separate configurable tiers.

title: Stable palette and dirty-only projection on source loss
acceptance: Palette/native names/qualified type never freshness-dim or gain STALE.
Lost source removes uncertain activity/attention, retains redacted detail; longturn silence stays active with valid source.
Dirty-only rendering and baseline-preserving rollback/reenable across reconnect.

title: Installed100tab resource and existing-host acceptance
acceptance: Exact immutable package CLI/stdio/API/MCP and source member equality.
100tab idle/active60s CPU<=1/5%onecore,RSS<=256MiB includingchildren,p95<=2s; coldstart separate.
Existing44+tab read-only measurement without layout/provider/agent effects; fresh cleanup/resource receipts.
Docs/help/completion and truthful accepted/deferred limits; no production enable/deployment.
